moved.sentence: Describe each module's responsibility in one sentence without using "and" — if you cannot, split it

judged.note: The rule keeps at SHOULD describing each module's responsibility in one sentence without "and" and splitting it if you cannot.

moved.sentence: Keep UI rendering, business logic, and data access in separate layers that can change independently

judged.note: The rule keeps at SHOULD keeping UI rendering, business logic and data access in separate, independently changeable layers.

moved.sentence: When a change to one feature forces edits in an unrelated feature, treat it as a coupling defect

judged.note: The rule keeps the cross-feature-edit condition and treating it as a coupling defect, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Counterweight — locality of behavior: separate by *reason to change*, but co-locate by *reason to read*.

judged.note: The rule keeps the locality-of-behavior counterweight: separate by reason to change, co-locate by reason to read, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Separation and locality pull in opposite directions; choose per case rather than maximizing either.

judged.note: The rule keeps choosing per case rather than maximizing either, and rationale keeps that separation and locality pull in opposite directions.
